description: Machine-readable anchor for the 2B.1 writer-migration cutover. Used to re-arm the in-process drift cron from disk if the Replit workspace sleeps and the in-memory node-cron schedule is lost. Companion to RESUME.md (human-readable handoff).
cronProcessHint: tsx server/index.ts (parent of node child running server/2b1-drift-cron.ts in-process). On workspace resume, this PID will be stale — verify with `ps -p <pid>` and re-arm if dead.

recoveryProcedure.trigger: On Replit workspace resume after a sleep event, or any time the Start application workflow restart timestamp is later than a snapshot's `at`.
steps: 1. Read this file and check each snapshot whose `at` is in the past and whose `status` is still 'scheduled'.
2. For each missed snapshot, manually invoke server/2b1-drift-cron.ts -> runDriftSnapshot(label) in order.
3. Update this file's snapshot entry to status='completed' (or 'missed-then-recovered' if reconstructed after the fact) and append the actual run timestamp under `actualAt`.
4. If 2+ snapshots are missed AND now is within 6h of cutoverAt, halt cutover until at least one fresh in-window snapshot has run.
haltConditions: Drift delta exceeds anomalyThreshold (5%) on any snapshot.
Two or more snapshots missed inside the cutover window without recovery.
Cron PID is dead AND no recovery snapshot has been run.
